description: Angular component for configuring count widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: CountWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for count widget settings, extending PageComponent, implementing ControlValueAccessor, managing form state and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls, sets up value change subscriptions, and updates validators dynamically.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on external disabled state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided widget settings and updates validators.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates current form value to registered change callback.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables or disables form controls based on other control values.
